prayer_requests.text: Please pray for the healing of Tom Brady, who is recovering from surgery.
Prayers requested for the Gonzalez family who lost their home in a fire.
Please keep Fr. Michael in your prayers as he begins his cancer treatment.
Prayers for safe travel for the youth group attending the diocesan retreat.
Please pray for the repose of the soul of SK Robert Henderson, who passed away peacefully.

events.description: Monthly council business meeting. All members welcome.

events.title: Parish Family Breakfast
events.description: Monthly breakfast following the 9:00 AM Mass. Free-will offering benefits seminarians.

announcements.title: Spring Charity Dinner
announcements.details: Join us for our spring charity dinner benefiting local families in need. Suggested donation $25/plate.

announcements.title: Volunteer Sign-Up for Parish Festival
announcements.details: The annual parish festival is approaching. We need volunteers for setup, food booths, and cleanup. Sign up at the council office.

announcements.title: New Member Welcome Reception
announcements.details: Council 830 will host a welcome reception for new members on Saturday June 13. Refreshments will be served following the 5:00 PM Mass.
